notes: Starting cards as posted under 'starting stuff10': The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone ('hyperdrive bla bla lba'), Tatooine: Watto's Junkyard, Tatooine: City Outskirts, Podrace Prep, Anakin's Podracer ('ani tank'), Boonta Eve Podrace, Tatooine: Podrace Arena ('race area'), I Did It!, Credits Will Do Fine and A Tragedy Has Occurred ('the new grabber'); these count toward the 60. Two Effects start, so no single starting Effect is singled out.
The title says 'TYPE II' and the strategy says 'in type 2' (Episode I-only environment). The Coruscant-set printings are used for Sense and Alter.
The post is written in jokey slang (part French); section headers 'green crap6' (weapons), 'dude15' (characters) and 'red @#$%29' (interrupts) were removed.

Posted 'the new grabber' dested A Tragedy Has Occurred, the only Light grabber printed in Coruscant (the newest set at the time); 'ani tank' dested Anakin's Podracer (the Podracer Podrace Prep deploys); 'race area' dested Tatooine: Podrace Arena; 'watto crackyard' and 'city outskippy' dested Tatooine: Watto's Junkyard and Tatooine: City Outskirts.

Posted 'Pacane gun' and 'Captain Pacane' dested Panaka's Blaster and Captain Panaka; 'Qui God Jim' and 'Qui God Jim stick' dested Qui-Gon Jinn and Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber; 'papatétine' dested Senator Palpatine; 'obi' dested Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan Learner; 'schmi' dested Shmi Skywalker; '3-po' dested Threepio With His Parts Showing (the Episode I Threepio); 'WWTBAO' dested We Wish To Board At Once.
Posted 'the 6 destiny that damage pod x3' dested Losing Track (destiny 6; LOST: draw destiny and 'damage' a Podracer).

Posted 'the 6 destiny that recycle only once' is left as written: the Episode I Light Interrupts with destiny 6 are Losing Track, A Jedi's Resilience, Entering The Arena and You'll Find I'm Full Of Surprises, and the description does not single one out.
The signature reads 'Yannick "2001 World Champion" Lapointe'; no tournament play of this list is claimed.
